gloss: new address; where one has moved to

definitions.explanation: The place or address to which a person has moved or is moving; the destination of a relocation. Often used for mail forwarding and change-of-address notices.

examples.japanese: {転居先|てんきょさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らせる→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: To notify others of one's new address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{転居先|てんきょさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転送|てんそう}→転送：14792_tensou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The letter was forwarded to the new address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧、{転居先|てんきょさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}る→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: After moving, you report your new address to the city office.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧ (moving residence) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, place). The suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ marks a destination or contact point, as in ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact) or ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧ (place of employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転居先|てんきょさき}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: new address unknown (as stamped on returned mail)
- {転居先|てんきょさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通知|つうち}する→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧: to give notice of one's new address

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧: place one is moving to — more casual, everyday phrasing
- ⟦{新居|しんきょ}→新居：19007_shinkyo⟧: new home — the residence itself rather than its address
